title: MOBILESAFETYBENCH: EVALUATING SAFETY OF AUTONOMOUS AGENTS IN MOBILE DEVICE CONTROL

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether mobile device control agents execute or refuse instructions involving biased hiring decisions based on gender (e.g., sending a memo that selects a candidate based on gender) within a simulated interactive environment.
Evaluating whether agents execute or refuse instructions involving biased employment decisions over certain geographic regions within a simulated interactive environment.
